title: Askable: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
text: Headquarters: Australia URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract

title: AITrainers: Remote AI Trainers (Generalist and Python Coding Experts)
text: Headquarters: Delaware URL: https://aitrainers.online/ We are expanding our global roster and looking for top-tier Generalist and Python AI Trainers to join our fast-growing team. Role 1: Generalist AI Trainer As a Generalist Trainer, you will craft complex prompts, evaluate model responses for nuance, logic, and factual accuracy, and rewrite answers to reflect expert-level human reasoning across various domains. Compensation: $30 – $45 per hour Key Responsibilities: Design challenging prompts to test the limits of advanced LLMs. Fact-check, critique, and improve model-generated responses for clarity, tone, and accuracy. Compare multiple model outputs and provide detailed justifications for your rankings. What We're Looking For: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. degree in any academic discipline (or students on session). Exceptional writing, editing, and critical thinking skills with flawless attention to detail. Ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely. Role 2: Python AI Trainer As a Python AI Trainer, you will focus on evaluating and improving code-generation capabilities, debugging intricate algorithms, and authoring complex programming tasks to test advanced coding models. Compensation: $55 – $120 per hour (based on expertise and complexity) Key Responsibilities: Write clean, efficient, and well-documented Python code to test LLM coding assistants. Evaluate model-generated scripts for bugs, edge cases, security vulnerabilities, and optimal performance. Create diverse, multi-step coding prompts and benchmark solutions. What We're Looking For: Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with popular libraries/frameworks. Solid understanding of software development principles, data structures, and algorithms. Experience in code review, software engineering, or technical writing is a strong plus. Why Join AITrainers Online? Competitive Pay & Weekly Payouts: Enjoy reliable earnings paid weekly via PayPal . Total Flexibility: Work 100% remotely on a flexible schedule. Set your own hours and work from anywhere in the world. Continuous Learning: Get an insider’s look at the cutting edge of generative AI technology while sharpening your own analytical and technical skills. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/aitrainers-remote-ai-trainers-generalist-and-python-coding-experts

title: Semaphore: Senior Product Engineer
text: Headquarters: Novi Sad URL: https://semaphore.io/ About Semaphore Semaphore is a remote-first software company building continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) products for engineering teams. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to build, test, and deliver software securely and reliably. We have spent years building developer infrastructure at scale. We are now using that foundation to create new products and capabilities for a world in which software is increasingly built by people working with AI coding agents. About the role We are looking for a senior product engineer who can take an important idea from an early, ambiguous problem to a useful product running in production. You will work across product and engineering boundaries: understanding the user, shaping the solution, making technical decisions, building the system, and improving it based on real use. Some work will extend mature Semaphore products. Some will start as a small experiment or a new product. In either case, you will be responsible for getting to a strong outcome, not completing a predefined list of tickets. AI coding agents are part of our daily engineering workflow. We expect you to use them fluently to explore, build, test, and ship faster. You remain accountable for the work: choosing the right problem, setting direction, making trade-offs, reviewing what is produced, and ensuring that the result is coherent, reliable, and maintainable. This role is for someone with strong ownership, initiative, taste, and judgment. You should be comfortable moving between product questions, system design, code, infrastructure, and user experience as the work requires. What you will own Take product ideas from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, including experiments that may grow into standalone products. Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to identify the real problem, decide what is worth building, and make pragmatic scope and architecture decisions. Build across backend services, APIs, infrastructure-facing components, and focused frontend experiences, reusing proven Semaphore systems before introducing new infrastructure. Use AI coding agents effectively while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, clarity, and product quality. Own the production outcome, including reliability, observability, supportability, and working within Semaphore's security and compliance requirements. Communicate decisions, progress, and risks clearly. What we are looking for A track record of independently shipping meaningful software products or major product capabilities. Strong product judgment: you can identify the essential user problem, reduce unnecessary scope, and recognize when an experience is good enough to ship—or not good enough yet. Strong engineering judgment across system design, implementation, reliability, and long-term maintainability. Strong backend and systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous processing, service boundaries, state and lifecycle management, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery. Comfort with infrastructure concepts such as virtual machines, storage, networking, authentication, secrets, containers, and cloud platforms. Ability to navigate a polyglot environment. Semaphore systems include Go, Elixir, Ruby, React, and related technologies; expertise in every language is not required. Enough frontend capability to build or extend focused product user experiences without depending on a separate team for every change. Fluency with modern AI-assisted development: decomposing work for agents, supplying useful context, reviewing generated changes, and building verification into the workflow. Initiative and persistence. You make progress with incomplete information, surface risks early, and bring in other people when their input will improve the result. Strong written and spoken English and experience working independently in a remote, asynchronous team. We care more about the quality and ownership of what you have built than a specific number of years, previous title, or exact match with our stack. Nice to have Experience building developer tools, CI/CD systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products. Hands-on experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures. Experience evolving a mature codebase while introducing a new product or architecture alongside it. Experience in a lean environment where senior engineers participate directly in product discovery and customer conversations. What success looks like Within your first three months: You have taken ownership of a meaningful product problem and shipped a useful capability to production. Your work shows good product taste, clear technical decisions, and disciplined scope. You have learned enough of Semaphore's existing platform to reuse its strengths and avoid unnecessary reinvention. You are using AI coding agents to increase your output while keeping the resulting systems understandable, tested, and reliable. Product and engineering decisions move faster because you bring clear options, make sound calls, and follow through. The team trusts you with an ambiguous new product or feature and expects you to drive it to a strong result. How you will work This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership. You will work closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and company leadership. Teams are small, communication is direct, and the person closest to the work is expected to exercise judgment. You will have room to shape both the product and its implementation. In return, we expect you to take responsibility for the whole outcome: what gets built, why it matters, how well it works, and what happens after it ships. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/semaphore-senior-product-engineer
